newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo palladium, platinum surge on Russia news.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo palladium, platinum surge on Russia news.

text.p: Yen-based palladium and platinum futures surged on Thursday, following gains in New York overnight on fears over a possible strike at Russian producer Norilsk next month.

All Tokyo palladium futures contracts gained by their daily 22 yen limit, with the benchmark February 1998 standing at 568 yen per gram. Platinum futures were 45 to 50 yen higher, with the February 1998 contract up by its daily 50 yen limit to 1,489 yen per gram. "News about a possible strike accelerated buying orders. If a strike takes place, shipments of Russian metals may be delayed further," a brokerage house trader said.
